en.headline: Observatory cancels overnight thunderstorm warning before dawn
en.dek: The alert was lifted at 4.45am after isolated storms over the New Territories; Thursday is forecast to be dry with sunny periods and a high near 32C.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory cancelled a Thunderstorm Warning at 4.45am on Thursday after isolated thunderstorms overnight over the New Territories.

A weather bulletin issued while the warning was in force said it would remain effective until 5.30am, with isolated thunderstorms expected over the New Territories. Between 2.45am and 3.45am, rainfall of up to 23 millimetres was recorded in the North District, with smaller amounts in Yuen Long and Tai Po. A special weather tip issued at 2.35am had warned that showers and thunderstorms developing around the Pearl River estuary could bring heavier rain in parts of Hong Kong over the following two to three hours.

No warning was in force later on Thursday morning. The Observatory said a northeast monsoon is affecting the south China coast. The forecast for Thursday is mainly cloudy with a few showers in the morning and at night, dry with sunny periods by day, temperatures from 26 to 32 degrees, and moderate east to northeasterly winds, fresh offshore and on high ground.

zh.headline: 天文台清晨取消通宵雷暴警告
zh.dek: 警告於上午4時45分取消，新界北部清晨錄得超過20毫米雨量；周四日間大致乾燥，最高氣溫約32度。
body: 香港天文台周四凌晨發出雷暴警告，其後於上午4時45分取消。警告生效期間，預料新界有局部地區雷暴。
警告仍有效時的天氣報告指，警告有效至上午5時30分。上午2時45分至3時45分，北區錄得最多23毫米雨量，元朗及大埔亦有少量降雨。天文台在凌晨2時35分發出特別天氣提示，指珠江口一帶持續有驟雨及雷暴發展，預料未來兩三小時本港部分地區雨勢較大。
周四上午稍後已沒有警告生效。天文台表示東北季候風正影響華南沿岸。周四預測部分時間有陽光，早晚有一兩陣驟雨，日間乾燥，氣溫26至32度，吹東至東北風4級，離岸及高地5級。
